meta.name: saas-idea-validator
meta.description: Evaluates a software or startup idea against problem, market, competition, monetization, defensibility, and execution, and returns a verdict rather than encouragement. Use this when an idea needs pressure-testing before anyone builds, when deciding whether something is worth pursuing, when assessing competition or willingness to pay, or when a validated idea needs a first-customers and MVP plan. Default to scrutiny; the useful answer is usually the unwelcome one.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用无情评审验证创业想法,得到可行结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有创业想法但希望在投入开发前被严格检验。
copy.tagline_en: Validate your startup idea with rigorous, honest scrutiny.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a raw idea that needs tough validation before any code is written.

howto.what: 评估软件或创业想法时，Claude会从问题、市场、竞争、盈利、防御、执行六方面拷问，最后给出“值得做”“有条件做”“换方向”或“别做”的明确判决，而非鼓励。
howto.when: 当你介绍一个软件或创业想法，明确要求评估可行性、判断是否该开发、检验竞争或支付意愿，或为已验证想法规划首批客户与MVP时，会触发。

say.text: 帮我评估这个SaaS点子：给独立设计师做自动开发票工具。
say.note: 会按六要素逐项拷问并给出明确判决。

say.text: 这个“宠物AI诊断”想法值得做吗？直接说结论别鼓励。
say.note: Claude默认挑刺，可能给你“别做”或“重构”的答案。

say.text: 为什么我搜不到同类产品？这是好事吗？
say.note: 它会追问用户当前的替代方案，指出“没人做”常是坏信号。

howto.what_en: When a user presents a software or startup idea, Claude pressure-tests it across six dimensions—problem, market, competition, monetization, defensibility, execution—and gives an explicit verdict (pursue, pursue if, reframe, do not pursue) instead of encouragement.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user asks to evaluate a software/startup idea, decide if it is worth pursuing, assess competition or willingness to pay, or plan first customers and an MVP for a validated idea.

say_en.text: Assess this SaaS idea: automatic invoicing for freelance designers.
say_en.note: It interrogates each dimension and returns a clear verdict.

say_en.text: Is this 'AI pet diagnosis' idea worth pursuing? Skip the pep talk.
say_en.note: It defaults to scrutiny and may say reframe or do not pursue.

say_en.text: Why can't I find any competitors—is that a good sign?
say_en.note: It probes what people do instead; 'no one does this' is usually a red flag.
